summary: Exited at -10.0pts after three consecutive new lows (-4.75 -> -7.25 -> -10.0) with ER10 collapsing from 0.71 down to 0.03, signaling the move had stopped being noisy chop and become an efficient (low-friction) trend against the position; 1m lambda_hat_12 also flipped strongly negative and significant (t=-4.44), confirming trend continuation rather than mean-reversion. Next time I'd weight the ER10 collapse more heavily and earlier -- it was the clearest divergence from the prior chop regime (where ER10 hovered 0.4-0.7 and price oscillated -5 to +3 without breaking new ground), and would consider exiting one frame sooner once ER10 crossed below ~0.1 rather than waiting for a third consecutive new low.
